targets: original recorded side-to-move outcome and recorded move; no added games or book labels

dataset.filters: complete games; placements 8..56, stride 3; 8-symmetry/color-relative position dedup; test/validation ownership before train
dataset.split: native converter canonical first 8 moves; no move-wise split
dataset.target: recorded final black disc difference / 64, from side-to-move view

labels.label: first same-split, same-board/turn and same-outcome recorded next move
labels.split: unchanged frozen opening-group splits and symmetry-deduplicated positions
labels.passPolicy: existing cache excludes pass targets; forced pass is deterministic at inference

nativeTests.batchContract: C8/C16/C32 x H16/H32/H64; batches1/8/32/128; NNUE baseline, failure recovery and exact endgame proof

training: from scratch per configuration; same seed and separate identical sample/augmentation RNG as width sweep; full epochs, no early stopping
selection: save both fixed validation MSE+CE minimum and validation value MSE minimum; use joint minimum for primary selection across configurations; all test evaluation after all training

evaluationRecovery.reasonForTolerance: FP32 convolution accumulation order differs between PyTorch and native SIMD; probability error is measured on every held-out position; exact selected moves and native metrics also recorded

nativeSpeed.backend: identical virtual-visit scheduler and Accelerate matrix backend; cold search
nativeSpeed.limits: Four positions, two timed positions; speed diagnosis, no strength claim
